steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier A
steps.text: That girl's been here for days now...

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier B
steps.text: Well, she hasn't been causing trouble, just doing some cleaning. That's not against General Zuo's orders. Let her be.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: As soon as I dust off the sand, another layer forms... Did Uncle Meng have to clean this much?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: The weapon racks, the tables, and the chairs are all repaired; the tiles are stuck back on, and the forge is lit up...

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Looks more or less like how Shifu described it.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: ...Did you need me for something?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: They say that since Uncle Meng left, the Sword Forge is now under your care.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Shifu would always talk about this place when she was alive, and Uncle Meng treated me kindly. I want to make it look like it used to.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: They told me to find you. I can help. Cleaning, repairing, anything's fine.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: No thanks, I don't need help to keep this place tidy.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: What's the point of making it look like how it did back then? Not like anyone's coming back.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: Can't nail down what doesn't belong.
Jieyun lifts her head and looks at the Sword Forge.
Every detail of this place cherished by its owner, every chair and table, the tools they refused to replace despite the years... She managed to restore some of these worn-out things.
But the people came and went, until finally, she was the only one left standing here.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: No, it's not the same. This still isn't the Sword Forge.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: There should be people here. People fighting, people drinking...

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: May I ask where I can find people to fight outside of the arena?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: If you don't know, then could you two fight me?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier B
steps.text: ...Certainly not.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Then do you know where I can find people to drink with?

steps.name: Half-Drunk Martial Artist
steps.text: I keep telling you not to drink so much! Look at you! You can barely stand!

steps.name: Drunken Martial Artist
steps.text: So what? Anyway, we need to go soon, so if you wanna drink more then drink already...

steps.name: Drunken Martial Artist
steps.text: You must've seen it too. The arena got smashed up by the Catastrophe, and someone took the rankings board away... Just one last look at the Sword Forge before we go.

steps.name: Half-Drunk Martial Artist
steps.text: Fine, fine, just one last look... Don't tell me you're still thinking about the Grandmaster, Meng and whoever it was that got you into competitions?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Do you two want to fight me?

An Anasa girl stands at the door as she looks at the pair of fighters, the chakram in her hand shining as bright as her eyes. Behind her, a couple of soldiers from the Patrol Battalion look on helplessly.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: You know kung fu, right? You can fight—err, compete with me.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: You must have come here to compete, yes?
It's clear that she isn't joking. The two martial artists look at her, then at each other.
Once, there was a woman who had her brow raised as high as this girl's. She too called at them, and yelled: 'Come! Let me see if the two of you lazed about instead of training!'
Once...

steps.name: Half-Drunk Martial Artist
steps.text: Yeah! Have at you!

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier A
steps.text: In the name of General Zuo, you are not to come any closer—Hey, you two—

steps.name: Drunken Martial Artist
steps.text: The stage is set, so let us commence with introductions. O Yumen, city of wandering warriors, whose heroism shakes the sky! I am Zhang Chong, Yumen's Maestro of Erlangquan! 'Tis a pleasure!

steps.name: Half-Drunk Martial Artist
steps.text: Haha! And I, Lin Feisha, am the fifty-sixth inheritor of the 'Single-Stroke Sword of the Sands' technique!

steps.name: Half-Drunk Martial Artist
steps.text: State your name, lady, and from whence you hail!

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: J—Jieyun, Anasa.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier A
steps.text: Hey, the hell do you think you're doing, taking up a stance?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier A
steps.text: Wh—What should we do? Arrest these troublemakers?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier B
steps.text: ...I'm going to move those two stools aside.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier A
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier B
steps.text: The arena needs to be kept clear during a match, doesn't it?
The soldiers silently take two steps back, and the once-quiet courtyard now thrummed with the sound of flurrying fists once more.
Spurred on by drunken courage and the sand-laden wind, the martial artists shoot forward, their arms a blur of blows as they try to suppress Jieyun from using her weapon.

steps.name: Drunken Martial Artist
steps.text: Haha, yes, that's it! This is how it should be! Mark well the four sides of the arena, how neat and straight they are...

steps.name: Half-Drunk Martial Artist
steps.text: What tripe! If you want to talk about how the ring should be, then what were you reaching for just now? Don't think I don't know about your hidden weapon!

steps.name: Drunken Martial Artist
steps.text: And what's wrong with that? I worked hard learning how to use it! Haven't I saved your sorry behind with it before?

steps.name: Half-Drunk Martial Artist
steps.text: It's a match in the ring! No hidden weapons!

steps.name: Drunken Martial Artist
steps.text: Fine, fine, I won't use it. But according to custom, until the match begins, you must seal the point of your blade in pine resin!

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Very well. I'll set aside my chakram too.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Come at me!

steps.name: Drunken Martial Artist
steps.text: You're on!
A few rounds ago, Jieyun noticed the drunken state of her opponents. Their footwork was sloppy, and their attacks were clumsy. All she needed was a single blow to knock them out of the ring.
But...

The more the pair fight, the clearer their eyes become. The more blows they send out, the more disciplined their strikes. As if this is no mere post-drink bout they joined on a lark, but a true match in the ring...
Even though they are already out of regular moves.
She can't help but slow her offensive.

steps.name: Half-Drunk Martial Artist
steps.text: Haha! I knew it was a good idea to tell you to drink less!

steps.name: Drunken Martial Artist
steps.text: What're you laughing at? We need to keep pushing forward!

steps.name: Drunken Martial Artist
steps.text: You're supposed to be going all-out during a match, lady! I can tell you're going easy on us!

steps.name: Drunken Martial Artist
steps.text: You can't do that! Give us everything you've got!

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Haaaaah!

steps.name: Half-Drunk Martial Artist
steps.text: Uaaagh!

steps.name: Drunken Martial Artist
steps.text: *cough* *cough* Wh—What an amazing strike, lady!

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier B
steps.text: Yeah! That's how you do it! Err...

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier B
steps.text: *cough*.
Jieyun wipes away the thin layer of sweat above her brow. The forge is roaring, and the fight is taxing, leaving everyone with red faces from the heat.
The Anasa girl has not yet come down from her battle high, but she feels like now would be a good time for a stiff drink.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Are you thirsty?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Liedaozi. The wine you're always drinking.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Half-Drunk Martial Artist
steps.text: Ah, that fragrance! That's the stuff!

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier A
steps.text: For us?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier A
steps.text: Not while we're on duty.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier B
steps.text: Look, don't keep holding that bowl up like that, miss... We've got our orders...
The Anasa girl does not move her hand an inch, her eyes as clear as the Liedaozi in the bowl.
If he did not acquiesce, she would probably stare at him for days on end.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier B
steps.text: You—I—*sigh* Fine.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Shifu said I should toast like... this.
The bowls clink against one another, producing a crisp note just as they once did many years ago. Wine splashes out and soaks into the sandy ground.
Fighter and soldier alike raise their bowls in the Sword Forge's courtyard. They then raise their heads and drain the booze dry.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: So that's what it tastes like...
It dawns on the Anasa girl.
She understands why the people of Yumen love to fight, and why everyone can make peace afterwards and drink together.
She understands why her shifu liked this place so much.
Jieyun bends down, scoops up some sand soaked with wine and puts it into a pouch.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Now this place is like the Sword Forge you told me about, Shifu.
At first, Jieyun was considering saying something more, or joining everyone for another cup of wine, or start singing to the sandstorm and the pagoda tree like Shifu said she used to...

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier A
steps.text: Alright, well, it was nice having some fun with you all.

steps.name: Sober Martial Artist
steps.text: Sure was...

steps.name: Sober Martial Artist
steps.text: The last convoy out of the city's about to arrive. We should head off now.

steps.name: Sober Martial Artist
steps.text: We managed to have one last match before we left. It was worth coming over...

steps.name: Sober Martial Artist
steps.text: Jianghu zai jian, lady. Don't forget today's match. It might be Yumen's very last one.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: 'Very last'...

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: That can't be—Eh? You...
The martial artists do not respond.
They stand up, place down their bowls, then walk away as they kick up dust. They do not look back.
Jieyun watches them as they walk off. Their gait is steady, as though they were not drinking just now. As though they were never drunk. As though all that just happened had not.
Why 'very last'?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier A
steps.text: ...Hey, what's the big idea? Just walking off after they're done fighting?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier A
steps.text: And why'd you let them walk away anyway? Not scared they're going to cause more of a ruckus after drinking?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier B
steps.text: Didn't you see the luggage they had by the doorway? I know those two. They're not from Yumen. Seems like they're leaving the city to head back to their hometown.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier B
steps.text: It's the last time they're leaving, too. They just wanted to come here for a match, and that was their last match ever.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier B
steps.text: Can't nail down what doesn't belong.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier B
steps.text: But... They really put their all into that fight today.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier A
steps.text: Oh...
So that's what that meant.
Can't nail down what doesn't belong.
One day later

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: About the Sword Forge, Jieyun...

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: I don't think what I said was wrong, but that day at the Forge, I was too hard on you...

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: *sigh* Would you like to stay in Yumen?

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: I've got a fair few friends here. No matter what you're thinking of doing, I can help find a place willing to take you in.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Shifu's content now, and I managed to have a real fight here. I rather enjoyed it.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I'll be heading off soon myself.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: Where're you headed?
Jieyun does not answer. She walks out of Yumen's gates, slowly singing a song.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: The sun goes down, east next morn, it rises up again ♪

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: The moon comes up, west next morn, we'll see it sink below ♪

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: The cracks fill out arid rock and through the soil, next year's raindrops will wet them as they land ♪

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: The shrubs deep in the sands are dried and die, and springs below will bring them back to life ♪
A gale blows past, carrying along the surging sands rushing out of the sand channels, covering up Jieyun's figure as it fades into the distance.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I've seen Jiangnan, and tried some water chestnuts, and also met the people of the jianghu that Shifu talked about.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I think... I'll do some wandering of my own. See what's around.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: See things that can really make me like Shifu, with lots and lots of memorable people and things to talk about.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier A
steps.text: We're here for our punishment, General Zuo.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier B
steps.text: While on duty yesterday, we drank without leave. According to military law, we are to be caned for our transgression.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier B
steps.text: The seal has already been written, General. The one for the Sword Forge...?

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: You don't need to ask me about that matter again.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Since you drank that wine yourselves that day, you can decide for yourselves as well.
